close_reason: mise.toml + scripts/mise-exec.sh landed in PR #67. Gate green from clean checkout; toolchain pinned (node 24.13.0, pnpm via packageManager, rust 1.97.1); Vite build exclusion decision recorded inline and in PR.
description:
## Background

Beadsmith needs one reproducible quality-gate command, but currently quality commands are spread across package scripts, hooks, Worktrunk, agent prompts, and an external Devin environment. The repository now has mise 2026.8.12 available, and mise can provision Node and Rust while reading pnpm’s exact version and checksum from the existing `packageManager` field.

This issue creates the canonical task graph. Later issues will connect Lefthook, Worktrunk, and documentation to it.

## What to build

Add `mise.toml` and a generic mise executable launcher so the repository can run a complete, pinned quality gate without relying on globally active Node, pnpm, Cargo, rustfmt, or Clippy versions.

## Technical Approach

Add `mise.toml` with:

- `min_version = "2026.8.12"`;
- `idiomatic_version_file_enable_tools = ["pnpm"]`;
- Node `24.13.0`;
- Rust `1.97.1` with the `default` profile;
- repo-wide tasks for `check`, `fix`, `typecheck`, `test`, React Doctor, Ultracite Doctor, Rust formatting, Rust format checking, Rust check, Rust Clippy, and Rust tests;
- a `gate` task depending on frontend lint/format, frontend typecheck, frontend tests, Rust format check, Rust Clippy, and Rust tests;
- hook adapter tasks with `raw_args = true` for staged Ultracite, staged React Doctor, and staged Rust formatting.

Use `pnpm exec` for every Node-local tool. Do not use `pnpm dlx` or `npx` in quality tasks.

Add `scripts/mise-exec.sh` only as a generic launcher that resolves `MISE_BIN`, `command -v mise`, or the standard `$HOME/.local/bin/mise` path. It must not define quality commands.

Use `cargo clippy --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --all-targets -- -D warnings` unless the Rust baseline issue documents an approved alternative.

The initial gate intentionally does not include the Vite build. If mergeability must guarantee a successful application build, add a mise `build` task and include it in the gate before closing this issue.

## Considerations

- The existing `packageManager` checksum is the pnpm source of truth; do not duplicate the version in `mise.toml` unless idiomatic resolution proves unsuitable.
- `mise install` must install all tools together so pnpm’s Node dependency is available.
- Explicitly trust the repository config before installation. Do not auto-trust from a git hook.
- The task graph should use mise’s normal parallel dependency execution; validate output and serialize only if needed.
- This issue depends on the Rust baseline and shared ignore policy so `mise run gate` can be green when introduced.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `mise.toml` exists with the specified minimum mise version, toolchain configuration, and task graph.
- [ ] `mise tasks validate`, `mise tasks deps gate`, and `mise run --dry gate` succeed.
- [ ] `mise install` succeeds on macOS ARM and provisions Node, pnpm, Rust, rustfmt, and Clippy.
- [ ] `mise x -- node --version` reports `v24.13.0` and `mise x -- pnpm --version` reports `11.23.0`.
- [ ] `scripts/mise-exec.sh` is executable, has no quality command definitions, and reports an actionable error when mise is unavailable.
- [ ] `mise run gate` passes from a clean checkout after the baseline issue is complete.
- [ ] The Vite build inclusion decision is recorded explicitly.

## Test Plan

- Test both idiomatic pnpm resolution from `packageManager` and the complete `mise install` flow in a disposable directory.
- Run `mise tasks validate` and inspect the dependency graph.
- Run `mise run check`, `mise run typecheck`, `mise run test`, and all Rust tasks individually.
- Run `mise run gate` in a clean checkout.
- Run `sh -n scripts/mise-exec.sh` and verify its executable bit.

## Triage

ready-for-agent

## Implementation plan

1. **mise.toml** (new, repo root):
   - Top-level `min_version = "2026.8.12"`, `[settings] idiomatic_version_file_enable_tools = ["pnpm"]` so pnpm resolves from the existing `packageManager` field (no version duplication).
   - `[tools]`: node 24.13.0, rust { version 1.97.1, profile "default" } (default profile ships rustfmt + clippy via rustup).
   - Tasks: `check`, `fix`, `typecheck` (tsc --noEmit), `test` (vitest run), `doctor:react` / `doctor:ultracite` (kept distinct per epic), `rust:fmt`, `rust:fmt-check`, `rust:check`, `rust:clippy` (default policy: --all-targets -- -D warnings; bsm-9n1.1 documents no approved alternative), `rust:test`.
   - `gate` depends on check, typecheck, test, rust:fmt-check, rust:clippy, rust:test — parallel via mise's normal dep execution (cargo's own target-dir lock handles rust task contention).
   - Hook adapters with `raw_args = true`: `hook:ultracite-staged` (appends staged files to `ultracite fix`), `hook:react-doctor-staged` (react-doctor reads the git index itself via --staged; callers pass no file args), `hook:rust-fmt-staged` (mirrors current lefthook invocation, staged files after `--`).
   - All Node-local tools invoked via `pnpm exec` — no dlx/npx.
2. **scripts/mise-exec.sh** (new, executable): generic launcher resolving $MISE_BIN → `command -v mise` → $HOME/.local/bin/mise, execs with "$@", actionable error (exit 127) when missing. No quality commands.
3. **Vite build decision**: gate excludes the Vite/tauri build. Rationale: gate covers lint/format/typecheck/unit-test quality; application build is exercised by e2e scenario pipelines (e2e:build) and packaging. Decision will be recorded in the PR body and here.
4. **Verification**: disposable-dir idiomatic pnpm resolution test; `mise trust` + `mise install` in worktree; version assertions (node v24.13.0, pnpm 11.23.0); `mise tasks validate` / `mise tasks deps gate` / `mise run --dry gate`; each task individually; full `mise run gate`; `sh -n` + exec bit on the launcher.

title: Add canonical mise toolchain and quality gate
